_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Declares the RJ270Stage schema that SettingsService::seedRj270Stages() has been seeding into since add-shillinq-consultancy-project-accounting task-14, but which was never declared in any register config. Without this schema every InitializeSettings run logged 'Shillinq: RJ-270 stages seeding failed' because OpenRegister could not resolve the RJ270Stage schema slug. The shape mirrors lib/Settings/seeds/rj-270-stages.json (4 canonical percentage-of-completion stages per RJ 270 / IFRS 15 §B14-B19); deduplication key is stageId. Project.recognitionStage mirrors the recognitionStage values of this catalogue.

RJ270Stage.title: RJ-270 Stage
RJ270Stage.description: Canonical percentage-of-completion stage definition for consultancy project revenue recognition under RJ 270 (Richtlijnen voor de Jaarverslaggeving §270) and IFRS 15 §B14-B19. Seeded idempotently from lib/Settings/seeds/rj-270-stages.json by SettingsService::seedRj270Stages() (dedupe key: stageId). Project.recognitionStage mirrors the recognitionStage values of this catalogue.

stageId.description: Stable identifier of the stage; deduplication key for the idempotent seed.
stageId.title: Stage ID

description.description: What the stage means for percentage-of-completion revenue recognition.
description.example: Project is in the initiation phase. Contract signed; work not yet substantially commenced. Percentage-of-completion: 0-10%.
description.title: Description

completionRangeLow.description: Lower bound (inclusive) of the completion percentage range for this stage.
completionRangeLow.title: Completion Range Low

completionRangeHigh.description: Upper bound (inclusive) of the completion percentage range for this stage.
completionRangeHigh.title: Completion Range High

recognitionStage.description: Canonical stage value mirrored by Project.recognitionStage.
recognitionStage.title: Recognition Stage

statutoryNote.description: Statutory basis note (RJ 270 / IFRS 15 reference) for auditor review.
statutoryNote.example: RJ 270 §3.2: revenue recognised only to the extent of recoverable costs in early stages.
statutoryNote.title: Statutory Note

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a RJ-270 Stage is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
